name: propoojapaath-design
description: ProPoojaPaath design kit: pandit app (website and Expo), ops console, public pages, logo motion, and a showcase site.

scripts.build: esbuild showcase/src/main.tsx --bundle --minify --outfile=docs/app.js --jsx=automatic --loader:.png=file --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' && cp showcase/index.html docs/index.html && rm -rf docs/assets && cp -r assets docs/assets && touch docs/.nojekyll
